say:1:1123624001:1.text: Two days ago, a group of warriors-in-training traveled to the desert for their trial.
say:1:1123624001:1.source_cn: 前两天，有一批实习战士前往沙漠，进行成为战士的正式试炼。

say:2:1123624002:1.text: But I just found out that an accident took place during their trial. Several warriors went missing amidst a sandstorm.
say:2:1123624002:1.source_cn: 但我刚刚得知，试炼的途中发生了意外。有几名战士在沙暴中...

say:3:1123624003:1.text: Those who made it back sustained heavy injuries, so they can't go out again to find the others. I really need your help in locating our <style="highlight">missing warriors</style>.
say:3:1123624003:1.source_cn: 回来的那些人也都受了不少伤，暂时无法再出去寻人。所以我...
say:3:1123624003:1.male: Those who made it back sustained heavy injuries, so they can't go out again to find the others. I really need your help in locating our <style="highlight">missing warriors</style>.
say:3:1123624003:1.female: Those who made it back sustained heavy injuries, so they can't go out again to find the others. I really need your help in locating our <style="highlight">missing warriors</style>.

say:4:1123624004:1.text: The sandstorm happened near the <style="highlight">south side of the desert</style>. I'm counting on you, Magister.
